lead_raw_text:
The structure of Er6Cu4 (reduced formula Er3Cu2) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a unit cell containing 10 atoms across four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only analysis shows Cu centers with 8 neighbors (4 Cu, 4 Er) and 10 neighbors (4 Cu, 6 Er), while Er centers adopt 12-neighbor close-packed-like and 14-neighbor environments. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 10 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Cu- and Er-centered polyhedra.
